# mistershell_ca_certificate (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell ca_certificate by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_ca_certificate" "example" {
  id = "123"
}

# Alternatively, resolve one exact name.
data "mistershell_ca_certificate" "by_name" {
  name = "corporate-ca"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `days_remaining` (Number) Days remaining.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) Fingerprint sha256.
- `is_ca` (Boolean) Is ca.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer.
- `not_after` (String) Not after.
- `not_before` (String) Not before.
- `pem` (String) Pem.
- `public_key` (String) Public key.
- `san` (Dynamic) San.
- `serial` (String) Serial.
- `signature_algorithm` (String) Signature algorithm.
- `subject` (String) Subject.
- `version` (String) Version.
